title: Set a default YouTube playback speed
question: How do I make YouTube always play at 1.5x speed?
answer: YouTube's desktop site has no setting for a default playback speed. Picking a speed in the player's Settings menu, or with Shift+> and Shift+<, is not saved as a default. The usermods script on this page starts every video at 1.5x, and you can change the number at the top of the script. You can still change the speed by hand during a video. Without an extension, press Shift+> twice at the start of a video.
prompt: Make every YouTube video start at 1.5x playback speed.
details:
The script waits for each new video to load in the player and sets its speed through YouTube's own player, so the Settings menu shows the new speed. It runs again when you click through to the next video without a reload.

To use another speed, edit `const SPEED = 1.5;` at the top of the script. YouTube's menu goes from 0.25 to 2.

It only acts when a new video loads, so a speed you pick by hand stays until the next video.

alternatives.title: Keyboard shortcuts
alternatives.body: Shift+> speeds the video up by 0.25 and Shift+< slows it down. From 1x, two presses of Shift+> give 1.5x. You have to do it on every video.

alternatives.title: Video Speed Controller
alternatives.body: The Video Speed Controller extension for Chrome and Firefox sets speed on any HTML5 video, with keyboard shortcuts and a remembered speed.
